To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a fully-integrated buck DC-DC converter with 80% efficiency, 80MHz switching frequency, 1.2 mm2 area and 6.7 nH package bondwire inductive is proposed.

a fully-integrated buck DC/DC converter is proposed with 80% peak efficiency and precise DCM operation, utilizing package bondwire as inductor and with adaptive dead time to enhance the light-load efficiency.
a 80MHz fully integrated area-efficient package-bond-wire-based buck converter with 8x efficiency improvement at 100μA is presented.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a high frequency buck converter with enhanced light-load performance, which can be used for a variety of low voltage applications.
the light-load efficiency enhancement of fully-integrated buck converters.
the design and optimization of an 80MHz fixed-frequency buck converter with package bondwire based inductors and enhanced light-load performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work is a breakthrough in the field of on-chip inductor design and fully-integrated DC-DC converter design, which is a significant contribution to the field of fully-integrated power management.
the presented work has demonstrated the feasibility of a package bondwire based fully-integrated buck converters with enhanced light-load and high-frequency efficiency.
the proposed converter with package bondwire inductive solution is a good alternative for fully-integrated buck converters with high efficiency, low cost and small area.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed buck converter is the most area-efficient buck converter with the highest frequency and the highest efficiency among the fully-integrated buck converters with package bondwire inductive element.
the proposed converter is the first buck converter which can achieve 80% efficiency at 80MHz and 270mA with package bondwire inductive solution.
the proposed converter is a fully-integrated buck with precise DCM and enhanced light-load performance which is area efficient, cost effective, robust and reliable.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed ADT controller is a generic solution that can be applied to any buck converters to improve light-load efficiency and reduce reverse current at high frequencies.
the proposed buck converter is a good candidate for low power applications with high switching frequency and high efficiency.
package bondwire based inductor is capable of achieving 80% light-load efficiency and 80MHz fully integrated buck converter with precise light-load efficiency control.
